scenario: concurrent MCP artifact downloads with an initially cold client tool-schema cache
observations: The initial 14-worker workflow reached all expected terminal states; the MCP session failed during 11 concurrent downloads.
Fresh-session serial and two-concurrent download probes passed.
Fresh-session four- and eleven-concurrent probes each received one tool result, then timed out after 30 seconds waiting for SDK result validation to request tools/list.
With the tool schema preloaded, eleven concurrent downloads plus twelve concurrent status-many requests passed on the old runtime.
root_cause: The SSH download child inherited MCP fd 0 and could consume subsequent JSON-RPC requests, including tools/list. Files could arrive while the client remained waiting for protocol responses.
secondary_cleanup_errors: RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration
fix: Use subprocess.DEVNULL for download stdin; verify a cold MCP session with eleven concurrent downloads after rebuilding the standalone runtime.
evidence_scope: Synthetic workflow; raw SDK replies, stderr, downloaded files and probing logs remain in ignored .local/workflows/multitask.
